rationale: The plan correctly identifies the paired structure and blocks on subject with ~ subject + condition in DESeq2, with an edgeR QL cross-check under the identical design and an explicit justification for not needing duplicateCorrelation given the balanced fixed-effect design. QC precedes testing with library sizes, blind VST PCA and distance heatmap annotated by both subject and condition, plus a stated expectation that subject dominates PC1 and a no-drop reporting policy — only the downstream action if a pair member deviates is left slightly implicit, relying on Cook's flagging. Filtering (>=10 counts in >=5 samples, justified as smallest group size), in-model median-of-ratios/TMM normalization with no pre-scaling, explicit reference level and contrast direction, BH at alpha 0.05 with independent filtering and apeglm shrinkage on the coefficient are all handled correctly and separate outlier-NA from filter-NA counts. Enrichment is optional here but is specified well: full ranked list by Wald stat with the metric named and defended, tested-gene universe, human Hallmark with version, 15-500 size window after intersection, and a fail-loudly rather than substitute policy. The report step names design, contrast, thresholds, versions, tested and DE counts, method overlap, and the n=5 power caveats.
